title: Formalisation in the Lean theorem prover of the relation between corner-free sets and communication complexity

source.citation: A. K. Chandra, M. L. Furst, R. J. Lipton, Multi-party protocols, STOC 1983, pp. 94-99
source.scope: whole (corners, NOF model, lower/upper bounds for eval)
source.evidence: README: "The definitions, theorems and proofs in this repository are taken from the now classic multi-party protocols paper of Chandra-Furst Lipton (link to gasarch PDF)". PDF is a 6-page scan (needs OCR).

edge_sample.target_text: definition Corner-free number: The {\bf $d$-dimensional corner-free} number of $G$, denoted $r_d(G)$ is the size of the largest set $A$ in $G^d$ such that $A$ doesn't contain a non-trivial corner.
